name: POST /api/leadflow/workflows/:id/dry-run - real history, zero effects
description:
Replays REAL historical records through a candidate definition and reports what WOULD have happened, with ZERO side effects (bd991d43-6c82-4842-a375-f62cb4a5439a#AC2).

ZERO BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY A FLAG. The simulation never receives a gateway client; it receives a recorder that counts the intention and returns. A dryRun boolean checked at each call site is one missed check away from a real message to a real customer, and the whole point of a dry run is that a reviewer trusts it enough to publish on its word. Any attempt to reach a real client is counted as an ESCAPE and fails the run.

REAL RECORDS, NOT SYNTHETIC ONES. A simulation over invented data proves the definition parses; a replay over the last fortnight's actual leads proves what it would have DONE, which is what catches "this rule would have messaged four hundred people".

COUNTED PER EFFECT CLASS - sends, tasks, stage changes, suppressions - because "412 things would have happened" tells a reviewer nothing and "308 messages would have sent" stops the publish.

AN EMPTY WINDOW DOES NOT PASS. A run over zero records proves nothing, and a reviewer reading "0 messages would have sent" from an empty window would reasonably conclude the rule is harmless. An unrecognised action also fails the run rather than being ignored - MEASURED LIVE, a definition with an unknown action scored 5000 escapes and did not pass, while a valid one replayed 5000 records with zero escapes.

testCases.name: A candidate replays real records and reports the effects it would have had
NEGATIVE: no version with that id
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the replay window is absent, non-numeric or outside the range.

errorCases.message: No workflow version with that id
errorCases.when: the version id does not exist.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
